snippet.title: Dream Delirio's | Official Trailer | Summer Game Fest 2026
snippet.description:
Dream Delirio's
Blast through waves of children’s nightmares with Magnus, a cereal mascot fighting to free the children from their fears. Weaponize your breakfast, build game-breaking card synergies and show these nightmares that crunch time is over.
